**[Open 1% cada día](https://mision-15-87f9fa.gitlab.io/)**

## How it works

On the **Hoy** (Today) screen, I can start a guided 15-minute session or log exercise I have already done. I can also edit the weekly plan and review my activity over time.

## How I built it

### Why I built it this way

I wanted to make it easier to keep an exercise routine on busy days. Starting with today's session keeps the next step clear, and manual logging means a workout can count even when I didn't follow the plan. The name reflects that intent: build consistency through small steps, not a promise of a measurable daily gain.

### Implementation and AI assistance

I chose an installable web app so I could use it from my phone without distributing it through an app store.

- **React** keeps the interface in step with changes: starting a timed session, logging an exercise, or editing the weekly plan updates what the user sees. Components let me reuse controls across those screens.
- **TypeScript** gives exercise definitions, workout records, and weekly plans explicit shapes. It catches mismatched fields during development, before a change reaches the app. It does not validate stored data by itself.
- **Vite and GitLab Pages** separate the build from hosting. Vite supports local development and packages the browser assets; GitLab Pages serves the result without an application server for the interface.

Without a connected account, IndexedDB stores records in the browser. A service worker caches the interface so it can reopen offline after an initial online load.

I used AI assistance to refine the exercise flow, implement features, and develop checks for behavior such as manual logging. The AI supported development; it does not choose the workouts.

The public link opens the interface, not my account or exercise history.
